cities.name: Paris
interests: Historic Monuments & Museums 🏛️ — From royal palaces to gothic cathedrals and world-famous museums.
Art & Culture 🎨 — Masterpieces, galleries, theatres and street artists everywhere.
Romantic Walks & Seine River Views 🌇 — Bridges, islands and glowing riverbanks at sunset.
Classic Parisian Streets 🏙️ — Haussmann boulevards, hidden passages and café corners.
Parks & Gardens 🌿 — Elegant green spaces perfect for breaks between sights.
cities.local_food_tip: Think crispy baguettes, buttery croissants, warm quiches, crêpes, cheese plates and delicate pastries. Try a café crème with a croissant in the morning, a classic crêpe in the afternoon and a simple cheese + bread plate in the evening for a very Parisian food day.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏛️ Start at Musée du Louvre (Louvre Museum) for the iconic glass pyramid and historic palace courtyards, or choose Musée d'Orsay (Orsay Museum) for impressionist art in a former train station. → 🌿 Walk through Jardin des Tuileries (Tuileries Garden) toward the Seine. → ⛪ Cross to Île de la Cité and circle around Cathédrale Notre-Dame de Paris (Notre-Dame Cathedral) and the riverside. → ☕ Pastry + coffee break near Shakespeare and Company bookshop and the Latin Quarter. Afternoon: 🎨 Take the metro up to Montmartre. Wander the artistic streets around Place du Tertre and climb the steps to Basilique du Sacré-Cœur (Sacré-Cœur Basilica) for a huge Paris panorama. → 🍽️ Lunch in a small bistro in Montmartre: quiche, gratin, salad or crêpes. → 🛍️ Optionally stop by Galeries Lafayette Haussmann for the glass dome and rooftop terrace view. Sunset: 🌇 Head toward the Eiffel Tower area. View the tower from Esplanade du Trocadéro (Trocadéro Square) as the city turns golden, then walk down to Champ de Mars for close-up views of Tour Eiffel (Eiffel Tower). → 🚤 Optional: evening Seine cruise from near Pont d'Iéna. Night: 🌃 Dinner in Saint-Germain-des-Prés or Le Marais — narrow streets, classic façades and lots of small restaurants. Finish with a slow walk over Pont Neuf or along the Seine as the monuments glow at night.

ideas: 🌸 Cherry blossoms and flowers in Jardin du Luxembourg (Luxembourg Gardens) and Parc des Buttes-Chaumont.
🎨 Street artists and local markets around Place du Tertre and the Latin Quarter.
☕ Outdoor cafés along Boulevard Saint-Germain with mild weather.
🚶 Long walks along the Seine banks and islands without summer crowds.
🌞 Extended daylight for pairing the Louvre or Orsay with relaxed Seine strolls.
🍨 Ice cream breaks on Île Saint-Louis while watching boats pass.
🎶 Outdoor concerts, open-air cinema and cultural events around squares like Place de la République.
🌇 Sunset picnics in Champ de Mars with the Eiffel Tower lighting up.
🍂 Autumn colors along Jardin des Tuileries and the banks of the Seine.
🧀 Hearty meals, onion soup and cheese plates in warm bistros.
🏛️ Museum days at the Louvre, Orsay or Centre Pompidou (Pompidou Centre) during rainy afternoons.
📸 Misty views from Montmartre and along narrow historic streets.
🎄 Christmas markets and lights along Avenue des Champs-Élysées and around major squares.
🔥 Hot chocolate and pastries in historic cafés like Café de Flore or Les Deux Magots.
🏛️ Extra time indoors at museums, galleries and theatres when it is cold.
✨ Nighttime walks to see the Eiffel Tower sparkle on the hour.

public_transport_tips: 🚇 Use the métro and RER lines to reach almost all sights quickly — stations are close together in the center.
🚶 Central Paris is very walkable, especially between the Louvre, Notre-Dame, the Latin Quarter, Le Marais and the Seine.
🎫 Consider a day pass (Mobilis) or Navigo Easy/Week card if you plan many metro rides in one day.
🚲 Try 'Vélib' Métropole' bikes for short rides along the river or through larger parks.
📱 Use the 'Bonjour RATP' app for real-time metro, bus and RER routes.

city_events.name: Fête de la Musique
city_events.description: 🎶 City-wide music celebration in June with free concerts and street performances in many neighborhoods.

city_events.name: Nuit Blanche
city_events.description: 🎨 All-night arts event with installations, performances and museums open late.

city_events.name: Paris Christmas Lights & Markets
city_events.description: 🎄 Illuminated avenues, decorated department stores and festive markets across the city.

cities.name: Nice & French Riviera
interests: Mediterranean Sea & Beaches 🌊 — Clear water, pebble shores and bright blue sea.
Coastal Walks & Sunny Weather ☀️ — Palm-lined promenades and endless sunshine.
Seafood & Coastal Cuisine 🐟 — Fresh fish, salads and Provençal flavors.
Colorful Old Towns 🎭 — Narrow alleys, local markets and lively squares.
Viewpoints & Cliff Walks 🌅 — Hills and coastal paths with big sea panoramas.
cities.local_food_tip: On the Riviera, think fresh: niçoise salads, grilled fish, ratatouille, socca (chickpea pancake) and lots of citrus and olive oil. Try a salad niçoise, a warm slice of socca and a simple fish dish along the seafront for a classic Mediterranean day.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🌊 Start in Nice on Promenade des Anglais (Nice Seafront Promenade) for a morning walk along the Baie des Anges. → 🏖️ Sit on the pebble shore near Plage Publique de Beau Rivage (Beau Rivage Public Beach) or another public beach spot. → 🥐 Breakfast in a café by Place Masséna (Masséna Square). Afternoon: 🏘️ Dive into Vieux Nice (Nice Old Town): colorful facades, tight alleys and souvenir shops. → 🌼 Browse the market at Cours Saleya for flowers and local snacks. → 🍽️ Lunch with salad niçoise, grilled vegetables or fish in a small old-town restaurant. → 🌅 Climb or take the lift up to Colline du Château (Castle Hill) for sweeping views over the bay and rooftops. Sunset: 🌇 Walk the Promenade des Anglais again as the sky turns pink and orange and watch the coastline lights slowly appear. Night: 🌃 Dinner at a seaside restaurant in Nice, then an easy stroll through the old town or along the marina. If you have extra time on another day, you can use local trains to visit nearby spots like Cannes or Antibes for more Riviera atmosphere.

ideas: 🌸 Strolling the quieter Promenade des Anglais before peak summer.
☕ Terrace cafés with gentle sea breeze in Vieux Nice.
🚶 Exploring the old harbor and Port Lympia (Nice Harbor) in soft light.
📸 Day trips to nearby hill towns under mild temperatures.
🏖️ Beach days with swims in the clear blue Mediterranean.
🍹 Seafood meals and light dishes by the water at sunset.
🎶 Nightlife along the seafront with music and a busy evening promenade.
🚤 Boat trips or coastal cruises between Nice and other Riviera towns.
🍁 Quiet beaches, golden sunsets and comfortable temperatures.
🥘 Hearty Provençal stews and warm seafood dinners.
📸 Soft afternoon light in Vieux Nice and from Castle Hill.
🚶 Coastal walks around Cap-Ferrat (Saint-Jean-Cap-Ferrat Peninsula) with fewer crowds.
🌬️ Breezy sea views from Promenade des Anglais under bright, crisp light.
🔥 Warm meals and hot drinks inside cozy seaside restaurants.
🕯️ Calm town mood and peaceful harbor with bobbing boats.
🌤️ Many sunny days compared to northern Europe — nice for off-season walks.

public_transport_tips: 🚊 Use the modern tram lines in Nice to move quickly between the airport, city center and port.
🚆 TER regional trains run along the coast and connect Nice with Cannes, Antibes, Menton and Monaco.
🚶 Old town, seafront and main squares in Nice are easily explored on foot.
🚗 Renting a car can help you reach smaller hilltop villages and hidden coves, but parking in city centers can be tricky in summer.
📱 Check 'SNCF Connect' or regional transport apps for Riviera train and bus schedules.

city_events.name: Carnaval de Nice (Nice Carnival)
city_events.description: 🎭 Colorful parades, giant floats and flower battles bringing huge energy to the Promenade and city streets.

city_events.name: Riviera Summer Beach Festivals
city_events.description: 🎉 Coastal concerts, seaside events and Mediterranean summer ambiance along the French Riviera.

cities.name: Lyon
interests: Historic Old Town & Renaissance Architecture 🏰 — Narrow traboules, stone houses and hidden courtyards.
Culinary Capital & Food Traditions 🍽️ — Famous for its rich cuisine, markets and traditional 'bouchons'.
Rivers & Relaxed Urban Vibes 🌉 — Life along the Rhône and Saône with bridges and quays.
Viewpoints & Hills 🌄 — Big panoramas from hilltop basilicas and parks.
cities.local_food_tip: Lyon is often called the culinary capital of France. Look for simple classics: vegetable soups, potato gratins, salads, local cheeses and pastries. Traditional 'bouchon' restaurants serve hearty recipes; you can always pick the milder, veggie-friendlier sides and desserts if you prefer something lighter.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏰 Start in Vieux Lyon (Old Lyon), wandering cobbled streets and peeking into 'traboules' (hidden passageways). → ⛪ Cross over to climb or take the funicular up to Basilique Notre-Dame de Fourvière (Fourvière Basilica) for a huge city panorama. → ☕ Coffee and pastry at a café on the way back down. Afternoon: 🏙️ Explore the Presqu'île between the two rivers: walk through Place Bellecour and Place des Terreaux. → 🏛️ Optional museum visit like Musée des Beaux-Arts de Lyon (Fine Arts Museum). → 🍽️ Lunch in a traditional bouchon or modern bistro with local dishes and sides. Sunset: 🌇 Head to the quays along the Quais de Saône (Saône River Quays) or Rhône riverbanks for golden reflections and relaxed walking. Night: 🌃 Enjoy dinner in Vieux Lyon or around Presqu'île, then stroll the illuminated bridges and riversides for a calm end to the day.

ideas: 🌿 Fresh produce markets around Halles de Lyon Paul Bocuse and neighborhood squares.
🎭 Local cultural events, small festivals and riverside animations.
☕ Outdoor café seating in Vieux Lyon and Presqu'île under mild temperatures.
🚶 Walks up to Fourvière with flowers blooming in the city below.
🌞 Relaxing on the grassy banks of the Rhône where floating bars and terraces line the river.
🍷 Light local meals and tasting boards in the evening after a warm day.
🌇 Sunset walks by the Saône with views of Fourvière lit up above.
🎶 Open-air concerts and cinema events on various quays and squares.
🍂 Autumn colors on riverside trees and in the hills surrounding Lyon.
🥘 Seasonal dishes and hearty meals in bouchons after exploring old streets.
🏛️ Museum visits and indoor galleries when weather turns rainy.
🍇 Day trips to nearby Beaujolais or Rhône wine regions to see harvest scenery.
🔥 Warm soups, gratins and desserts after crisp city walks.
🏙️ Exploring churches, museums and old buildings while staying indoors.
❄️ Occasional snowy views from Fourvière looking over the whole city.
✨ City lit up at night along the rivers and in Old Town passages.

public_transport_tips: 🚇 Lyon has a compact metro system that connects major districts and hill bases.
🚊 Trams and buses fill gaps and are great for reaching parks like Parc de la Tête d'Or (Tête d'Or Park).
🚶 Historic areas (Vieux Lyon and Presqu'île) are best explored fully on foot.
🎟️ Day-tickets can be useful if you plan to use multiple modes (metro, tram, bus) in one day.
🚲 Bike-sharing is available and pleasant along flat riverbanks.

city_events.name: Fête des Lumières (Festival of Lights)
city_events.description: ✨ Huge city-wide light festival in December transforming buildings, parks and squares with creative illuminations.

city_events.name: Lyon Food & Wine Week
city_events.description: 🍷 Local tastings, markets and events celebrating Lyonnaise food traditions.

cities.name: Bordeaux
interests: Wine Region & Vineyards 🍷 — Rolling hills of vines and historic châteaux.
Historic Port & Garonne River Views 🌉 — Long riverside promenades and elegant façades.
Gourmet Cuisine & Elegant Urban Vibes 🍽️ — Refined restaurants, markets and stylish streets.
Architecture & Squares 🏛️ — 18th-century stone buildings and grand plazas.
cities.local_food_tip: This region is famous for wine, but also for food: canelé pastries, fresh bread, cheese boards, vegetable dishes cooked in rich sauces and duck-based recipes. Even if you skip the wine, the markets and bakeries alone are worth the trip.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🌿 Take a short trip to nearby vineyards in areas like Saint-Émilion or Médoc for scenic vineyard views. → 🍇 Visit a wine estate exterior or vineyard path and learn about the landscape, history and grape varieties. Afternoon: 🏙️ Return to the city and explore the UNESCO-listed historic center: walk through Place de la Bourse and see the famous Miroir d'eau (Water Mirror) reflecting the buildings. → 🌉 Stroll along the Garonne river quays. → 🍽️ Lunch with regional dishes, cheese plates and local specialties. Optional: 🏛️ Visit La Cité du Vin (Wine Museum) exterior and surroundings for modern architecture and river views. Sunset: 🌇 Enjoy the sunset from the riverside near Pont de Pierre (Stone Bridge) or along the quai. Night: 🌃 Dinner in the historic center or the Quartier des Chartrons, then a calm evening walk under lit façades and along the water.

ideas: 🌸 Vineyards turn green again, great for early-season countryside walks.
🎨 Local markets, street art and cultural events in the center.
☕ Outdoor café terraces opening in main squares and quays.
🚲 Mild temperatures for biking between river and nearby vineyards.
🍷 Day vineyard visits combined with relaxed evenings on the Garonne quays.
🌙 Outdoor dining under warm nights with illuminated historic buildings.
🎶 Summer festivals and concerts along the riverfront.
🌊 Short trips to the Atlantic coast (like Arcachon) for sea breezes.

autumn.event: Harvest Time & Autumn Colors in Vineyards
ideas: 🍁 Golden and red vineyard slopes during harvest season, perfect for photos.
🥘 Seasonal regional dishes and tastings in and around Bordeaux.
🏛️ Museum or indoor cultural visits when days get cooler.
🚶 River walks with softer light and fewer tourists.
🔥 Warm bistro meals and indoor tastings on chilly days.
🚶 Quiet city strolls with winter lights reflected on the Garonne.
🛍️ Artisan shops and food markets for local products and souvenirs.
☕ Café stops in elegant 18th-century surroundings.

public_transport_tips: 🚆 Use regional trains or organized shuttles to reach vineyard areas and nearby towns.
🚊 The Bordeaux tram network is very handy for getting between the train station, riverfront and outer districts.
🚶 The historic center and quays are easily explored on foot.
🚲 Bike rentals or self-service bikes are a great way to follow the river paths.
📱 Use local transport apps or 'TBM Bordeaux' for tram and bus information.

city_events.name: Bordeaux Fête le Vin (Wine Festival)
city_events.description: 🍷 Large wine festival with tastings, riverfront events and celebrations of Bordeaux's wine heritage.

city_events.name: Bordeaux River & Light Nights
city_events.description: ✨ Light displays and riverside atmosphere in the darker months.

cities.name: Saint-Tropez
interests: Luxury Mediterranean Resort & Glamour 🛥️🌞 — Yachts, beach clubs and a famous harbor.
Beach & Côte d'Azur Lifestyle 🏖️ — Sun, sea and stylish seaside days.
Old Town & Harbor Views 🏘️ — Narrow streets, pastel houses and a lively port.
Nightlife, Yachts & Sunset Vibes 🍸 — Evening energy, music and coastal lights.
cities.local_food_tip: Expect light Provençal cooking: grilled fish, tomato and olive-oil salads, vegetable tarts, fresh bread and fruity desserts. Try a simple fish dish, a salade niçoise–style plate and a slice of 'tarte tropézienne' (local cream cake) for a sweet finish.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🛥️ Start at the picturesque Vieux Port (Old Port), watching boats and yachts in the calm morning. → 🚶 Wander the old quarter around La Ponche: narrow streets, pastel houses and quiet corners. → ☕ Coffee and pastry in a small square. Afternoon: 🏖️ Head out to Plage de Pampelonne (Pampelonne Beach) for a classic Saint-Tropez beach experience — public zones and famous beach clubs line the bay. → 🍽️ Lunch with Mediterranean salads, grilled vegetables or fish by the sea. Later: 🏰 Return to visit the exterior of Citadelle de Saint-Tropez (Saint-Tropez Citadel) for views over the town and gulf. Sunset: 🌇 Watch the sky change color over the harbor from the quays of the Vieux Port or from a higher viewpoint near the citadel. Night: 🌙 Dinner at a seaside or harbor-view restaurant. Walk the marina as the yachts light up and finish with a calm stroll through La Ponche's lamplit alleys.

ideas: 🌤️ Mild coastal weather on Pampelonne Beach before high season.
🚶 Old town exploration with fewer visitors, perfect for relaxed photography.
🍷 Trying local Provençal dishes in a calmer atmosphere.
📸 Harbor views with soft spring light.
🏖️ Full beach clubs, sunbeds and turquoise water days.
🌴 Evening walks along the harbor with music and buzzing nightlife.
🛥️ Boat trips and yacht culture along the Gulf of Saint-Tropez.
🍨 Ice cream and seaside snacks during warm nights.
🍂 Quieter beaches and warm but softer sunlight.
🥘 Coastal dinners with a more relaxed, non-crowded vibe.
📷 Seafront and citadel views under golden autumn skies.
🚶 Peaceful walks around the hills framed by vineyards and pines.
🌬️ Quiet promenades, empty beaches and reflective sea views.
🔥 Cozy restaurant meals with local olive oil, herbs and warm dishes.
🚶 Calm strolls along the harbor and through La Ponche under low winter sun.
🌌 Clear night skies and quiet coastal streets.

public_transport_tips: 🚌 In high season, regional buses and shuttles connect Saint-Tropez with nearby towns and transport hubs.
🚤 Ferries and boat shuttles can link Saint-Tropez with other Riviera points — especially in summer.
🚶 The old town and harbor area are compact and easily explored on foot.
🚗 In busy months, car traffic and parking can be challenging; consider park-and-ride or boat access when possible.

city_events.name: Les Voiles de Saint-Tropez
city_events.description: ⛵ Iconic sailing regatta bringing classic and modern yachts to the gulf.

city_events.name: Saint-Tropez Summer Beach & Yacht Parties
city_events.description: 🎉 Beach parties, yacht events and coastal nightlife with a glamorous summer atmosphere.

cities.name: Biarritz
interests: Atlantic Surf & Beach Culture 🌊🏄 — Strong waves, surf schools and sandy shores.
Basque Coast Cuisine & Seafood 🐟 — Local fish, pintxos and Basque specialties.
Relaxed Coastal Town & Stylish Vibes 🌅 — Elegant villas, promenades and cliff views.
Clifftop Walks & Viewpoints 🌄 — Scenic promenades overlooking the Atlantic.
cities.local_food_tip: Biarritz mixes French and Basque influences: grilled fish, seafood platters, pintxos (small tapas), sheep's milk cheese and Basque cakes. After time on the beach, grabbing a few pintxos and a dessert like 'gâteau basque' feels just right.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🌅 Begin with a walk or surf session at Grande Plage (Main Beach), watching surfers and Atlantic waves. → 🥐 Breakfast in a coastal café with sea views. Afternoon: 🚶 Explore the town center and food stalls at Les Halles de Biarritz (Central Market). → 🍽️ Lunch with seafood or Basque-style dishes near the market or seafront. → 🌉 Walk along the cliffs to Rocher de la Vierge (Rock of the Virgin) for dramatic coastal scenery. Later: 🏖️ Head toward Plage de la Côte des Basques for more surf atmosphere and big ocean views. Sunset: 🌇 Watch the sun sink into the Atlantic from the cliffs above Côte des Basques or near Rocher de la Vierge. Night: 🌙 Dinner with Basque cuisine in town, then a slow walk along the lit seafront promenades.

ideas: 🌊 Moderate waves and fewer crowds at Grande Plage and Côte des Basques.
🚶 Quiet town walks through elegant streets and viewpoint paths.
🍷 Early-season seafood and Basque dishes in relaxed restaurants.
📸 Fresh green hills meeting the Atlantic under clear spring skies.
🏄 Peak surf and beach life with surf schools and lively promenades.
🍨 Beach snacks, ice cream and outdoor dining near the shore.
🎶 Small festivals, music and coastal events in the warm evenings.
🌅 Long sunset sessions watching waves crash under orange skies.
🌬️ Cooler but still beautiful sea breeze along the cliff paths.
🔥 Warm seafood stews and Basque comfort dishes after walks.
🚶 Less crowded town and beaches, ideal for a slower pace.
🌫 Occasional dramatic skies and waves for moody photography.
🌧️ Stormy seas and big waves viewed safely from promenades and viewpoints.
🔥 Cozy meals, hot drinks and indoor comfort in local restaurants and cafés.
🚶 Reflective coastal walks in calmer weather windows.
🌌 Quiet nights with the sound of the ocean always nearby.

public_transport_tips: 🚆 Trains and regional buses connect Biarritz with cities like Bayonne, Bordeaux and other Basque Coast towns.
🚶 The center, beaches and main viewpoints in Biarritz are walkable.
🚴 Renting a bike or using local buses can help reach neighboring coastal spots.
📱 Check local transport and 'TER Nouvelle-Aquitaine' information for regional schedules.

city_events.name: Biarritz Surf & Sea Festival
city_events.description: 🌊 Surf competitions, beach parties, concerts and sea-themed cultural events along the coast.

city_events.name: Basque Culinary & Culture Days
city_events.description: 🥘 Tasting events, markets and performances highlighting Basque food and traditions in and around Biarritz.
